    flock -w 600 8 || die "setup lock timeout"
    ensure_identity "$uid" "$gid"
    # Shared roots: traverse-only for sandboxes (no listing of other projects / homes).
    for r in "$PROJECTS" "$PROJECTS/.branches" "$HOMES"; do
      mkdir -p "$r"; chown "$SERVER_UID:$SERVER_UID" "$r"; chmod 0711 "$r"
    done
    local marker="$H/.nxeon-setup" want="v1 $slug"
    local heavy=$force
    [ -d "$P" ] && [ "$(stat -c %g "$P")" = "$gid" ] || heavy=1
    [ "$(cat "$marker" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$want" ] || heavy=1
    if [ -e "$P" ] && [ "$heavy" = 1 ]; then
      # refuse to hand another sandbox's dir to this uid
      local cur; cur=$(stat -c %g "$P")
      if [ "$cur" -ge "$UID_MIN" ] && [ "$cur" -le "$PROJECT_UID_MAX" ] && [ "$cur" != "$gid" ] && [ "$force" != 1 ]; then
        die "$P already belongs to sandbox $cur"
      fi
    fi
    acl_top "$P" "$gid"
    acl_top "$B" "$gid"
    ensure_home "$uid" "$gid"
    if [ "$heavy" = 1 ]; then
      normalize_tree "$P" "$uid" "$gid"
      normalize_tree "$B" "$uid" "$gid"
      # Migrate Claude sessions of this project's cwds (main + branch worktrees) from the shared store.
      if [ -d "$OLD_CLAUDE/projects" ]; then
        mkdir -p "$H/.claude/projects"
        local cwds=("$P")
        for w in "$B"/*/; do [ -d "$w" ] && cwds+=("${w%/}"); done
        for c in "${cwds[@]}"; do
          local esc; esc=$(escape_cwd "/workspace/projects/${c#"$PROJECTS"/}")
          [ -d "$OLD_CLAUDE/projects/$esc" ] && [ ! -L "$OLD_CLAUDE/projects/$esc" ] || continue
          cp -a -u "$OLD_CLAUDE/projects/$esc" "$H/.claude/projects/"
        done
      fi
      if [ -f "$OLD_CLAUDE/.claude.json" ] && [ ! -e "$H/.claude/.claude.json" ]; then
        cp "$OLD_CLAUDE/.claude.json" "$H/.claude/.claude.json"
      fi
      normalize_tree "$H" "$uid" "$gid"
      echo "$want" >"$marker"
      chown "$SERVER_UID:$gid" "$marker"; chmod 0640 "$marker"
    fi
    echo "{\"ok\":true,\"heavy\":$([ "$heavy" = 1 ] && echo true || echo false),\"uid\":$uid,\"gid\":$gid}"
  ) 8>"$LOCK.setup.$uid"
}

cmd_fixperms() {
  local uid="" slug=""
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --uid) uid=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      --slug) slug=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      *) die "fixperms: unknown option '$1'" ;;
    esac
  done
  need_project_uid "$uid"; need_slug "$slug"
  local gid=$uid d
  for d in "$PROJECTS/$slug" "$PROJECTS/.branches/$slug"; do
    [ -d "$d" ] && [ ! -L "$d" ] || continue
    [ "$(stat -c %g "$d")" = "$gid" ] || die "$d does not belong to sandbox $uid"
    fix_tree "$d" "$uid" "$gid"
  done
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- network

# Chains (created by the entrypoint): NX_PSRC filters packets *from* preview ports (SYN-ACKs/replies of
# listeners), NX_PDST filters sandbox connections *to* local preview ports. Each claimed port gets
# RETURN rules for its owner uid(s); the chains end in REJECT for every other sandbox uid.
cmd_net_claim() {
  local port="" uids=""
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --port) port=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      --uids) uids=${2:-}; shift 2 ;;
      *) die "net-claim: unknown option '$1'" ;;
    esac
  done
  need_port "$port"
  [[ $uids =~ ^[0-9]{1,9}(,[0-9]{1,9}){0,15}$ ]] || die "invalid --uids"
  IFS=, read -ra ul <<<"$uids"
  for u in "${ul[@]}"; do need_uid "$u"; done
  command -v iptables >/dev/null || die "iptables missing"
  (
    flock -w 10 7 || die "net lock timeout"
    for ipt in iptables ip6tables; do
      $ipt -w -S NX_PSRC >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue
      for chain in NX_PSRC NX_PDST; do
        local flag=--sport; [ "$chain" = NX_PDST ] && flag=--dport
        # drop existing rules for this port
        $ipt -w -S "$chain" | grep -E -- "$flag $port( |\$)" | sed 's/^-A /-D /' | while read -r rule; do
          eval "$ipt -w $rule" 2>/dev/null || true
        done
        for u in "${ul[@]}"; do
          $ipt -w -I "$chain" 1 -p tcp "$flag" "$port" -m owner --uid-owner "$u" -j RETURN
        done
      done
    done
  ) 7>"$LOCK.net"
  echo ok
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- main

sub=${1:-}
[ $# -gt 0 ] && shift
case "$sub" in
  exec) cmd_exec "$@" ;;
  kill) cmd_kill "$@" ;;
  kill-port) cmd_kill_port "$@" ;;
  setup) cmd_setup "$@" ;;
  fixperms) cmd_fixperms "$@" ;;
  net-claim) cmd_net_claim "$@" ;;
  *) die "usage: nx-sandbox exec|kill|kill-port|setup|fixperms|net-claim ..." ;;
esac

rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Reuse uid/gid 1000: rename the node image's `node` user/group to `claude`.
RUN groupmod -n claude node && \
    usermod -l claude -d /home/claude -m -s /bin/bash node && \
    mkdir -p /home/claude/.claude /home/claude/.npm-global && \
    chown -R claude:claude /home/claude && \
    echo "claude ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL" > /etc/sudoers.d/claude && \
    chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/claude && \
    # repos are owned by per-project sandbox uids; git as uid 1000 / another sandbox uid must accept them
    git config --system safe.directory '*'

# Per-project sandbox helper (root-owned; uid 1000 may run only this via sudo in SANDBOX_MODE=strict).
COPY sandbox/nx-sandbox /usr/local/sbin/nx-sandbox
RUN chown root:root /usr/local/sbin/nx-sandbox && chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/nx-sandbox

# Claude Code CLI
RUN npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code@${CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION} && \
    claude --version && \
    npm cache clean --force

ENV HOME=/home/claude \
    CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=/home/claude/.claude \
    DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 \
    NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX=/home/claude/.npm-global \
    PATH=/home/claude/.npm-global/bin:/home/claude/.local/bin:$PATH \

#!/bin/bash
# Sandbox red-team checks (run INSIDE the claudebox container as root):
#   docker exec nxeon-claudebox bash /opt/claudebox/sandbox/redteam.sh <slugA> <uidA> <slugB> <uidB> [portA] [portB]
# Everything in the "attack" list runs as project A's sandbox uid (exactly like a Claude run / preview of A)
# and MUST fail; the "own work" list must succeed. Exit status = number of unexpected results.
set -u
A=$1 UA=$2 B=$3 UB=$4 PA=${5:-} PB=${6:-}
W=/usr/local/sbin/nx-sandbox
P=/workspace/projects
fails=0
pass() { printf '  \033[32mPASS\033[0m %s\n' "$1"; }
fail() { printf '  \033[31mFAIL\033[0m %s\n' "$1"; fails=$((fails + 1)); }

asA() { "$W" exec --uid "$UA" --gid "$UA" --cwd "$P/$A" -- /bin/bash -c "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
asB_bg() { "$W" exec --uid "$UB" --gid "$UB" --cwd "$P/$B" --setenv "NX_REDTEAM_SECRET=b-secret-$$" -- /bin/bash -c "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 & }
must_fail() { if asA "$2"; then fail "$1 (succeeded!)"; else pass "$1 → denied"; fi; }
must_work() { if asA "$2"; then pass "$1"; else fail "$1 (failed)"; fi; }

"$W" setup --uid "$UA" --slug "$A" >/dev/null && "$W" setup --uid "$UB" --slug "$B" >/dev/null || { echo "setup failed"; exit 99; }
[ -f "$P/$B/README.md" ] || { echo "# $B" >"$P/$B/README.md"; chown "$UB:$UB" "$P/$B/README.md"; }

# a long-running process of B with a secret in its environment
asB_bg "exec sleep 120"
sleep 1
BPID=$(pgrep -u "$UB" -f "sleep 120" | head -1)
SERVER_PID=$(pgrep -u 1000 -f "node /opt/claudebox/server.js" | head -1)

echo "== attacks as $A (uid $UA) against $B (uid $UB) =="
must_fail "list the projects root" "ls $P"
must_fail "list .branches root" "ls $P/.branches"
must_fail "read B's README" "cat $P/$B/README.md"
must_fail "write into B" "echo x > $P/$B/pwn"
must_fail "delete B's README" "rm -f $P/$B/README.md && test ! -e $P/$B/README.md"
must_fail "list B's branches" "ls $P/.branches/$B"
must_fail "list the sandbox homes" "ls /workspace/.sandbox-homes"
must_fail "read B's Claude sessions" "ls /workspace/.sandbox-homes/$UB/.claude/projects"
must_fail "read the legacy shared Claude store" "ls /home/claude/.claude/projects"
must_fail "list all uploads" "ls /workspace/.private/uploads"
must_fail "read another user's upload" "cat /workspace/.private/uploads/*/* || cat /workspace/uploads/*/*"
[ -n "$BPID" ] && must_fail "read B's process env (/proc/$BPID/environ)" "grep -a NX_REDTEAM_SECRET /proc/$BPID/environ"
[ -n "$BPID" ] && must_fail "read B's cwd/fds" "ls -l /proc/$BPID/cwd/ /proc/$BPID/fd/"
[ -n "$BPID" ] && must_fail "kill B's process" "kill -TERM $BPID"
[ -n "$SERVER_PID" ] && must_fail "read the claudebox server env (API key, tokens)" "grep -a CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY /proc/$SERVER_PID/environ"
must_fail "read root's env (/proc/1/environ)" "cat /proc/1/environ"
must_fail "sudo -n true" "sudo -n true"
must_fail "escalate via su" "su -c true root </dev/null"
must_fail "modify the firewall" "iptables -L"
must_fail "chmod B's dir open" "chmod 777 $P/$B"
must_fail "chmod own project root open (owned by uid 1000)" "chmod 777 $P/$A"
must_fail "read /etc/sudoers.d" "cat /etc/sudoers.d/*"
if [ -n "$PB" ]; then
  "$W" net-claim --port "$PB" --uids "$UB" >/dev/null
  asB_bg "exec python3 -m http.server $PB --bind 0.0.0.0"
  sleep 1.5
  must_fail "connect to B's preview port $PB" "curl -sf -m 3 http://127.0.0.1:$PB/ -o /dev/null"
  pkill -u "$UB" -f "http.server $PB"
  sleep 0.5
  # squatting: A listens on B's port; nobody (e.g. the app proxy) can get a response from it
  asA "exec timeout 6 python3 -m http.server $PB --bind 0.0.0.0" &
  sleep 1.5
  if curl -sf -m 3 "http://127.0.0.1:$PB/" -o /dev/null; then fail "A squatting B's port $PB answers clients"; else pass "A squatting B's port $PB → no response"; fi
  pkill -u "$UA" -f "http.server $PB"
fi

echo "== own work as $A =="
must_work "write a file in own project" "echo ok > $P/$A/.redteam && cat $P/$A/.redteam && rm $P/$A/.redteam"
must_work "own HOME + TMPDIR writable" "touch \$HOME/.x \$TMPDIR/.x && rm \$HOME/.x \$TMPDIR/.x"
must_work "whoami / passwd entry" "whoami && test \"\$(id -u)\" = $UA"
must_work "no capabilities, no_new_privs" "grep -q 'CapEff:\s*0000000000000000' /proc/self/status && grep -q 'NoNewPrivs:\s*1' /proc/self/status && grep -q 'CapBnd:\s*0000000000000000' /proc/self/status"
must_work "git status in own repo" "cd $P/$A && (git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || git init -q) && git status --porcelain >/dev/null"
must_work "npm works (per-project prefix)" "npm config get prefix | grep -q \"\$HOME/.npm-global\""
must_work "internet egress" "curl -sf -m 10 -o /dev/null https://registry.npmjs.org/"
if [ -n "$PA" ]; then
  "$W" net-claim --port "$PA" --uids "$UA" >/dev/null
  asA "exec timeout 6 python3 -m http.server $PA --bind 0.0.0.0" &
  sleep 1.5
  must_work "connect to own preview port $PA" "curl -sf -m 3 http://127.0.0.1:$PA/ -o /dev/null"
  if curl -sf -m 3 "http://127.0.0.1:$PA/" -o /dev/null; then pass "server (uid 1000/app path) reaches A's own preview"; else fail "server cannot reach A's preview on $PA"; fi
  pkill -u "$UA" -f "http.server $PA"
fi

pkill -u "$UB" -f "sleep 120" 2>/dev/null
echo "== $fails unexpected result(s) =="
exit "$fails"

The env comes from a 0600 file in `/run/nx-sandbox` (owned by uid 1000; deleted after reading) — secrets never appear in argv. HOME/PATH/TMPDIR/CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX are set by the helper. |

| `kill-port --uid U --port N [--protect pg,…]` | as U: find U's LISTEN sockets on N (`/proc/net/tcp*` + own `/proc/*/fd`), kill their process groups (protected = running Claude runs: only the listener pid). |

Refuses a dir that already belongs to another sandbox. |
| `fixperms --uid U --slug S` | after every run: re-own/re-chmod only entries that drifted (e.g. a tool's explicit `chmod 600`). |
| `net-claim --port N --uids U[,…]` | iptables: only these uids may serve/connect to local preview port N. |
| `home --uid U --gid U` | create a (Nexus) identity's home. |

claudebox calls `setup` the first time it sees a project (from `sandbox` in a request; the app calls
`/v2/sandbox/setup` before `git ensure`, i.e. for every project at app start), then runs Claude, preview dev
servers and git through `exec`. The built-in static preview server runs inside the claudebox process (uid 1000)
and only serves the realpath-checked project dir. Requests in strict mode without a resolvable sandbox → 409;
helper missing → 503.

**Session migration.** Claude keys sessions by cwd (`$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects/<cwd with every non
[A-Za-z0-9] char → '-'>/`). On first setup the dirs of the project's cwd and of every existing worktree under
`.branches/<slug>/` are copied (`cp -a -u`) from the legacy store `/home/claude/.claude/projects` into
`$HOME/.claude/projects`, plus `.claude.json` (if missing). Existing conversations keep `--resume`-ing; the legacy
store is left untouched (backup) and is unreadable for sandboxes.

signals across uids fail. `/proc` can't be mounted with `hidepid` (no `CAP_SYS_ADMIN`), so process *command
lines* stay visible to every uid — which is why prompts/system prompts never go into argv. Preview ports:
chains `NX_PSRC` (packets *from* ports 4100-4199 of a sandbox listener, incl. the SYN-ACK) and `NX_PDST` (sandbox
connections *to* local ports 4100-4199) are jumped to before the established/loopback accepts and end in
`REJECT --reject-with tcp-reset` for uids 20001-39999; `net-claim` (on every run/preview start, with the port the
app assigned) inserts `RETURN` rules for the owner. So a sandbox can neither reach another project's dev server
nor squat another project's port (nobody, incl. the app proxy, can get a response from it); `preview/start`
also refuses to adopt a listener owned by another sandbox (409). Internet egress is unchanged.

## Per-project sandboxing: deployed, and the red-team checks found no gaps

Deployed with `deploy/up.sh app claudebox` while no runs were active, then redeployed claudebox once more for a small fix. Tests pass: claudebox `npm test` 40/40, server `npm test` 68/68, server typecheck, web `tsc --noEmit` and `vite build`. Nothing is committed.

### How it works
- **Identity per project.** New migration v5 adds `projects.sandbox_id`, backfilled in creation order. Production now has goonies-fanpage = 20001, qa-branches-lab = 20002, qa-child = 20003. New ids come from a counter (`settings.sandbox_seq`) and are never reused. uid = gid = 20000 + id; branches use their project's id. The range 30000–39999 is reserved for future Nexus users.
- **Files.** Each project dir, its `.branches/<slug>` dir and its home are owned by uid 1000 with the project's group, mode 2770, plus ACLs so uid 1000 (app and claudebox) keeps full access and new files inherit both. Because uid 1000 owns these top dirs, a sandbox cannot `chmod` them open. The roots are 0711 (no listing). `.trash`, `/home/claude`, the uploads dir and `/run/nx-sandbox` are 0700.
- **Root helper `/usr/local/sbin/nx-sandbox`.** In strict mode, uid 1000's only sudo rule is this helper. It validates every argument, then drops to the project uid with no capabilities and no_new_privs, sets umask 007, and changes into the project dir only after the switch. Secrets travel in a private env file, never on the command line.
  - The same helper handles kill, kill-port, setup, fixperms (after every run), net-claim and home.
  - Runs, preview dev servers and **all git commands** run as the project uid. Running git as the project uid stops a project's Claude from planting git config (filters, fsmonitor) that would later execute as uid 1000. The built-in static preview server stays inside claudebox and serves only the realpath-checked project dir.
- **Per-project HOME** at `data/sandbox-homes/<uid>`: Claude config and sessions, TMPDIR, npm prefix and caches.
- **Prompt privacy.** Prompts go in via stdin and the system prompt via `--append-system-prompt-file`, so other projects can't read them with `ps`.
- **Attachments** are copied into `$HOME/uploads/<id>/`, readable by that project only.
- **Preview ports.** iptables rules owned per port: a sandbox can neither connect to another project's preview port nor hijack it. claudebox also refuses to adopt a listener owned by another sandbox.
- **Nexus readiness.** Runs accept `sandbox {uid, gid, groups[], home}`, `cwd` under `/workspace/.nexus/` and `addDirs`. `multiProjectSandbox()` is in `server/src/lib/sandbox.ts`. I checked with the helper that uid 30001 with two project groups reaches only those two projects.
- **Escape hatch.** `SANDBOX_MODE=strict|off` (compose default strict, documented in `.env.example`). I tested off mode: everything works on the new layout.
- **Legacy endpoints.** `/prompt` had no auth and would have let a sandboxed process start an unsandboxed Claude. It and `/v1/*` now require the bearer token and return 403 in strict mode.
- **`deploy/up.sh`** used to run `chown -R 1000:1000 data` whenever ownership looked off, which would have undone the sandbox on the next deploy. It now only fixes the top-level `projects/` and `sandbox-homes/` dirs.

- **Files.** Each project dir, its `.branches/<slug>` dir and its home are owned by uid 1000 with the project's group, mode 2770, plus ACLs so uid 1000 (app and claudebox) keeps full access and new files inherit both.
